reason: Under the value/transfer lens it fails as a standalone LB probe. The code facts are right: x138 cell 0 sets BIOHUB_REPAIR_DEADLINE_S=27000. Cell 5 _deadline_degrade switches off relink (with readmit inside it), gap close, gap2, safe divisions and linefit for every movie after the check at l.2115. With the validator off, cell 10 does not run a second pass. The guard comes from readmit-v1 (DIFF.md s.1), not from x138. But (1) PUBLIC GAIN IS ~0. 41 teams reproduce x138 at 0.953 to 3 decimals. A guard that fired inside the public embryo would start degrading at a different movie in each run, because hidden-run wall-clock jitter is tens of minutes over 7.5 h. A degraded movie is worth ~0.001 of public score (L~0.05 x ~1/30 of the public weight), so such runs would spread over several thousandths. No spread is seen, so the public movies are almost surely not degraded, either because the guard does not fire or because the public embryo sorts first. The realistic public gain is <= +0.0005, below the +0.002 bar, and a public tie cannot confirm or refute anything. (2) The PRIVATE value is real but unmeasurable and very sensitive to one unknown, x138's hidden runtime T. Our same-GPU-stack exp51 had a 7.5 h latency, which includes queue and scoring (CONTEXT l.1446/1495), so T~6.5-7.3 h is plausible. Model: fire if T>7.5 h; degraded fraction f=(T-7.5)/R, R = repair-phase length 1-2 h; L~0.045-0.055 per unit of degraded weight. Divisions: pooled div J (metrics.md l.142) and safe divisions are the only fork source (probe 26: 0.947->0.911), so 0.1*dJ = 0.0026 at f=0.1 and 0.0083 at f=0.3. Edges: linefit/gaps/relink ~0.01-0.02 per unit, lab numbers discounted. Result: E[private gain] = +0.0001..+0.007 for mu 6.5-7.0 h and +0.003..+0.013 for mu 7.3 h. Central ~+0.001-0.003 private, with a +0.01-0.02 tail if the run is slow. (3) TRANSFER is not the weak point. Lifting the guard only restores the base pipeline's own stages on the tail movies. No network-confidence rule, in-sample lab or 44b6 redundancy is involved. When the guard never fires the output is byte-identical. (4) Risk check: a fixed 36000 s is safer than the idea fears. The deadline is checked per movie at repair start and degraded movies are fast, so the finish time is at most deadline + one full repair + a fast remainder. It cannot cause a 12 h timeout unless the GPU phase itself nears 12 h, and the change does not touch that phase. Net: harmless, small positive private insurance, zero public signal. It does not merit its own slot and does not meet the +0.002 public bar.
fix_if_any: Do not probe it alone. Fold it as a zero-extra-slot rider into whichever x138-family file is submitted anyway as a final candidate (exp57b if #35 > #34, else exp56), so the slot is already paid for by the final. Make it budget-aware, not a fixed 36000 s. Before each movie: degrade only if elapsed + remaining_movies x 1.3 x p90(repair_seconds so far) > 39,600 s, with a hard fallback at 41,400 s. In degraded mode keep OUTPUT_SAFE_DIVISIONS and OUTPUT_LINEFIT_SMOOTH on and switch off only relink/readmit/gap stages. Divisions are ~0.036 of the ~0.05 per-movie loss (probe 26), and safe divisions plus linefit are cheap per movie. Pre-registered gates: (a) the dummy commit CSV is sha256-identical to the base, (b) no 'DEADLINE:' line appears, (c) the per-movie 'repair Xs | kernel elapsed' lines are printed. Then read the #34 latency when it scores. A latency under ~7.3 h means the guard almost surely did not fire, so the rider is pure insurance: include it anyway. A latency of 7.5-8 h with 0.953 is the signature of a guard that fired on private tail movies, which raises the rider's value to +0.005-0.02 private. Also put it into F2 if F2 is x138-based. Tell the user the public score of the rider build will tie by construction.
realistic_public_gain: ~0 (<= +0.0005). The 41 identical 0.953 reproductions imply the public movies are not in a degraded block. It is invisible at LB noise 0.003.
realistic_private_gain: Expected ~+0.001 to +0.003 (model: mu 6.5-7.3 h hidden runtime, R 1-2 h, L~0.05). Tail up to +0.01-0.02 if x138's hidden run is really >= 7.5 h. Exactly 0 if the run finishes before 7.5 h. Transfer to unseen embryos is not a concern: only the base's own stages are restored.
